name: Kalei Kanahele
source:
Kalei is your typical good-hearted angel that wants to help humans succeed in any way possible to get into Utopia.

The role as Limbo's shepherd is one not many would endure but he takes on the task willingly and with a smile, though his ambitions may be even too much for him to bear alone.
